pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal patches with moderate to high edge angularity. Pixel gradients at boundaries are distinct but softened by direct sunlight. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the neck and decreases significantly toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-tan interstitial network forming a negative-space web. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness is wide and relatively constant on the neck, narrowing into more complex, thin pathways on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, stiff mane is visible along the dorsal ridge. The silhouette displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration consisting of discrete hair clusters against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural thinning or gap in the mane continuity is visible at the anatomical junction where the neck meets the shoulder hump.

other_distinctive_markers: An oxpecker (Buphagus) is perched on the lateral-upper neck, creating a distinct, dark, non-biological pelage interruption.
